corrected: 13197: notes "Series badges printed: 10 and 15" -> merged series cell (10, 15, 25, 30, 40, 45) shared with 13199
13198: notes "Series badges printed: 10 and 15" -> merged series cell (10, 15, 25, 30, 40, 45) shared with 13200

2877: description "Black rubber cover that presses into a 15 series T-slot to close the slot opening, sold on a 150 foot roll." -> "Black rubber T-slot cover for 15 series profiles, sold per 150 foot roll."
12319: dimension_notes "A = overall height, D = overall width" -> "A = clip body height (base of body up to where the top arms meet), D = overall body width, C = width of the T-slot neck"
12026: dimension_notes "A = overall height, D = overall width" -> "A = clip body height (base of body up to where the top arms meet), D = overall body width, C = width of the T-slot neck"
2895: notes added that the self-adhesive footnote applies only to 2893/2894; series badge list made exact
remaining_doubts: 65-7212 (metric Cut to Length) is listed in the Required Machining Services table under the 15/40-badged 2119 table but was not extracted as a separate part; it is mentioned in the 40-2119 notes.
Cable Ties 2890, 2891, 2892 (page 9-40) have no Series column/badge, so they were not extracted although they are used with the cable tie mounts.
2119-72.5 and 2119-72.5-BLACK-FB weight cells print "124.45 kg" under .145 lb, which looks like a catalog error; 40-2119 weight ".06758 kg / mm" recorded verbatim.
Wire housing suggested hardware (3050/3201) is attached to the housings 13197/13199 only, not to the covers 13198/13200.
